caption: The image displays a textile piece composed of various colored bands and rectangular segments in red, blue, green, and off-white or cream. The textile features alternating bands with decorative motifs such as stylized flowers, leaves, and geometric patterns. Several rectangles and squares contain floral and leafy designs, with the colors alternating between red backgrounds with cream patterns, blue backgrounds with cream patterns, and green backgrounds with cream patterns. One central segment includes the text "MARGARET CARPER 1846" in cream lettering on a red background. A prominent section contains a large, stylized cream rose on a red background, and another segment features a diamond geometric shape with green dots surrounded by blue floral motifs. The textile appears to be woven, showing visible texture and some frayed edges, especially on the left and upper sides. The areas within the textile are divided by thin straight lines in varying colors that separate the different patterns and motifs.
